name: Automatic Flight Control Systems
summary: Design of autopilots, stability augmentation and fly-by-wire control laws that make aircraft safe and pleasant to fly.

topics.name: Flight control system architecture: sensors, computers, actuators
Stability augmentation: yaw dampers and pitch dampers
Heading, navigation and approach autopilots; autoland
Multivariable and robust control (LQR, H-infinity) for aircraft
Gain scheduling and nonlinear dynamic inversion
Actuator dynamics, rate limits and pilot-induced oscillation
Verification of control laws: piloted simulation and flight test
